settings.title: Refund & Return Policy
settings.subheading: Clear, customer-friendly return guidelines. If your order arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, our support team will promptly assist you.

settings.title: Clear Return Conditions
settings.text: Eligible return/replacement requests can be submitted within 15 days of delivery for damaged or defective items.

settings.title: Damaged / Wrong Items
settings.text: If an incorrect or leaking product arrives, we arrange a prompt replacement at zero additional shipping cost.

settings.title: Direct Refund Processing
settings.text: Approved refunds are credited back to your original payment method or UPI within 3–5 business days.

settings.heading: 1. Return & Refund Eligibility
settings.body: We accept return and replacement requests within 15 days from the date of delivery for items that arrive damaged, defective, leaking, or different from what was ordered. To be eligible for a return, the product must have at least 80% of its original liquid volume remaining.

settings.heading: 2. How to Request a Return or Replacement
settings.body:
To initiate a request, please email our support team at support@purelane.com or message us on WhatsApp (+91 9930 123 234) with:
• Your Order ID (e.g. #PL-1042)
• A brief description of the issue
• Clear photos or a short video showing any damage, leakage, or incorrect labeling.

settings.heading: 3. Damaged or Incorrect Product Handling
settings.body: Once our customer support team verifies the details, we will immediately initiate a free replacement order or issue a full refund according to your preference. In most damage cases, we do not require you to ship the broken or leaking bottle back.

settings.heading: 4. Refund Timelines & Payment Methods
settings.body:
• Prepaid Orders (Cards, Net Banking, UPI): Refunds are processed back to the original source bank/card within 3–5 business days.
• Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders: Refunds are transferred directly to your verified UPI ID or bank account within 24–48 hours of approval.

settings.default_body: We are dedicated to providing plant-powered homecare you can trust. If something isn't right with your delivery, our support specialists are here to resolve it.
